photos.title: File:20240107 Night view of Yong'an Li, Duolun Road.jpg

observations.part: Two second-storey compound awnings in the near complete narrow pair, top ridges/left and right scalloped edges, first canopy then second
Second-storey window opening below the right near canopy ordered upper left, upper right, lower right, lower left. Upper edge partly shaded and foreshortened.
Two scrolled panel returns in the right wide bay; these are on the wall below the sill.
Small slatted first-floor equipment screen: signed upper near-left and near-right corners plus right-hand protruding return
Other slatted box on third storey; front face left, right; projecting return and brackets visible underneath

overview.basis: 2024 image displayed full width 820 px and 546.7 px high. Coordinates below transformed back to original 1800 x 1200.
overview.count_limit: Three nearly complete pairs can be assigned securely to adjoining bays. More recede left. Edges at both ends and full count are outside this close view.

geometry: Each narrow window opening contains paired timber casements, with a vertical central member and several horizontal divisions. The two openings of the structural bay have separate domed canvas awnings, with an exposed central masonry pier between them. The closest single wide opening uses a full-width canopy.

A depth is directly visible on the domed canvas hood and on projecting slatted square boxes. The foreground windows share planar sill and head lines. The oblique photograph does not establish a projecting masonry bow window or an inhabitable balcony. Outboard rods result in ladders of fine lines; they are not permanent continuous balcony parapets.

The nearest pair gives a projected awning edge width/opening width roughly 1.10–1.28 and apparent dome rise/chord roughly 0.40–0.54. Scalloped lower hem, spaced narrow pale stripe and dark underside are visible. Estimated image variation +-5 px for controls, roughly +-0.06 on ratios. Depth is unmeasured.

2014 photograph shows aligned pairs, two storeys of stripes, same horizontal sill and panel divisions, plus passing laundry and slatted boxes. Photographs taken from the same forward-looking direction do not give stereometric depth or a separate rear view.
address_note: 图中最靠近的嘉业堂店招可读多伦路152号，距174号实测约34米。这里取相同排屋的罩形作对读。
